successes.name: kept
successes.source: FROM tickets AS old |> INFER `model-task:risk-score.v1` ITEM KEY (id) INPUT (text = text) KEEP (id, text AS note) AS assessment |> ORDER BY id

successes.name: omitted
successes.source: FROM tickets AS old |> INFER `model-task:risk-score.v1` ITEM KEY (id) INPUT (text = text) AS assessment |> ORDER BY assessment.input_key.id

successes.name: nested-filter
successes.source: FROM tickets AS old |> INFER `model-task:risk-score.v1` ITEM KEY (id) INPUT (text = text) KEEP (id, text AS note) AS assessment |> WHERE assessment.outcome = 'ok' AND assessment.value.risk = 'high' |> SELECT id, assessment.value.risk AS risk |> ORDER BY id

successes.name: empty
successes.source: FROM tickets AS old |> INFER `model-task:risk-score.v1` ITEM KEY (id) INPUT (text = text) KEEP (id, text AS note) AS assessment |> ORDER BY id
